description: A PHP class for the 'Modify Display' view in the SuiteCRM Connectors module. It manages the display of connector sources in the administration interface, providing module title parameters, tab name, and rendering logic for the view including retrieval and filtering of connector sources.

classes.name: ViewModifyDisplay
classes.description: A subclass of SugarView that handles displaying the 'Modify Display' page for connector sources within the admin panel.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the breadcrumb navigation links for the module title, linking to Administration and Connectors main pages, with a title for modify display.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the module tab, which is 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method that renders the view, retrieves connector sources, filters out disabled ones, and passes data to the template for rendering.
